name: Bright Smile Dental
tagline: Gentle, modern dentistry for the whole family.
greeting: Hello! 😊 Welcome to Bright Smile Dental. Can I help you book a visit or answer a question?

faqs.a: We accept most major PPO dental plans. Share your insurance name and we'll confirm coverage before your visit.

faqs.q: Do you see emergencies the same day?
faqs.a: Yes — call us as early as possible and we'll do our best to see you the same day.

faqs.q: I'm nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Our team specializes in anxious patients — we go at your pace and can discuss comfort options at your visit.

offers: New patients: exam, X-rays and cleaning for $99
policies: Bring your insurance card and photo ID to your first visit
goal: Book new patient appointments and collect contact details from people who are not ready to book yet
